definitions.explanation: The organs inside the body, especially those in the chest and abdomen, such as the heart, lungs, stomach, and intestines.

examples.japanese: {内臓|ないぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm careful about my diet to maintain the health of my internal organs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{内臓|ないぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The examination checked whether there were any abnormalities in my internal organs.

examples.japanese: {内臓|ないぞう}⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started exercising to reduce visceral fat.

notes:
{内臓|ないぞう} refers to internal organs collectively. {内|ない} means 'inside' and {臓|ぞう} means 'organ.'
